Pricing questions

How does the review management free trial work?

Start with a 30-day free trial of review automation. We set everything up with you and launch your first review campaign, and you're only billed on day 30 if you decide to stay. No contract, cancel any time.

Are there setup fees?

Not for review management, websites or profile management. The Local Growth System has a one-off $1,000 setup fee for your website build and onboarding, which we waive if you pay quarterly or longer.

Can I cancel any time?

Yes. No lock-in contract. Cancel any time. There's no exit fee on any service.

Can I start with one service and add more later?

Yes. Many businesses start with reviews, then add a website or profile management. Upgrade to the full system whenever you like and nothing resets.

Do you offer pricing for multiple locations or franchises?

Yes. Get in touch and we'll put together a bundle for your locations.
